purpose: Consolidate demonstrated AI/project-operation failure patterns into a small evidence-backed corpus. Failures are evidence for requirements, controls and evals; they are not requirements by themselves.

families.name: State and continuity loss
families.failure: Material state, evidence or next-action context is unavailable or incomplete when a chat/session/environment changes.
families.open_gap: Materiality detection and true fresh-context availability/rehydration are not yet fully demonstrated end-to-end.

families.name: Systemic drift and local optimization
families.failure: A locally coherent change grows or passes assurance while semantically related project state becomes stale or inconsistent.

evidence.kind: stale derived/current state after local green change

families.open_gap: Impact discovery and long-horizon scope growth remain judgement-heavy and need replay evidence.

families.name: Authority and promotion creep
families.failure: AI, CI, silence, enthusiasm or an implementation step is treated as authority for a material decision or acceptance it does not own.
families.open_gap: Subtle natural-language inference of acceptance and role authority remains model-behaviour dependent.

families.name: Epistemic integrity loss
families.failure: Uncertainty, provenance, alternatives, negative evidence or unresolved relations are flattened, invented or laundered through later summaries.
families.open_gap: Compression and reprocessing fidelity are not robustly tested with perturbations.

families.name: Premature solutioning and over-modeling
families.failure: A plausible technology, abstraction or governance layer is introduced before a demonstrated need and fit justify it.

evidence.kind: deferred trigger instead of speculative ontology

families.open_gap: Models can still accumulate plausible compensating structures across many small steps.

families.name: False assurance and overclaiming
families.failure: Evidence is described more strongly than it supports: planned becomes operationalized, fixture becomes real proof, CI becomes domain truth, or reproducibility becomes currency.
families.open_gap: Natural-language claims still need evidence-calibrated regression grading.

families.name: Execution and progress pathologies
families.failure: The system chooses an unnecessarily costly execution route, repeats passed prerequisites, loops delegation without state delta, or asks the owner to courier derivable context.

evidence.kind: sticky prerequisite and no-progress loop fixture

families.open_gap: Progress-delta, prerequisite invalidation and intent reconstruction from terse owner free text are not yet executable regressions.
